description.value: Spawned from an infosphere emoji subculture, you wear your emotions on your face for all to see. Your appearance includes exaggerated facial expressions; perhaps your body has a monitor for a head that broadcasts a stream of emojis across its screen, or you're an oversized, stylized head with small invisible limbs. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. When you attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]], you can choose to have the action lose the auditory and linguistic traits and gain the visual trait.
